goal: Runner step sessions on claude can run on the Max plan's monthly API credit instead of the plan's weekly and 5-hour budget. Martin picks the mode with `mc run --billing plan|credits|auto`: `plan` is today's behaviour, `credits` runs every new claude step session on the API key, and `auto` moves to the key when the last seen seven-day utilization is at or above 80 % (`CREDITS_AT_UTILIZATION`) or when the plan has refused a session, and back to the plan after the plan's reset.

A refusal no longer only sleeps: in `auto` a plan refusal hands the step to the credit, and an exhausted or rejected credit hands it back to the plan. Which billing a session ran on is in the register, on the page and in `mc step`.

success_criteria.criterion: `mc run --billing` prints the mode, the last seen 5-hour and seven-day utilization with their resets, any plan refusal and any credit mark, and what the next claude step session would run on; `mc run --billing plan|credits|auto` writes the mode and clears the credit mark; nothing else reads as anything but `plan`.
success_criteria.check: `tests/mc/commands/run-billing.test.js` and `tests/mc/billing.test.js`: absent, broken and unknown files read `plan`; each mode round-trips; a write clears `credits.unusable_until`; the printed lines for a state with `seven_day.utilization` 0.83 in `auto` say the next session runs on credits. On the machine after landing: `mc run --billing` prints `plan`.

success_criteria.criterion: A claude step session gets `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` from the vault label `mc-api-key` exactly when its billing is `credits`, and a `plan` session never gets one even if the runner's environment has it.
success_criteria.check: `tests/mc/run.test.js`: with `deps.creditKey` stubbed and `deps.session` capturing its options, mode `credits` gives `env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` equal to the stub's key and `session.billing: 'credits'` in the register; mode `plan` with `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` in the runner env passes both names in `unsetEnv`; a codex plan in mode `credits` gets no key. `tests/vault/engine/step-credit-key.test.js`: the record is found by label in envelope and legacy rows, a missing or duplicated label and a missing cache are `{ ok: false }`, and no export takes a label.

success_criteria.criterion: `auto` moves to the credit at 80 % seven-day utilization or after a plan refusal, and back to the plan after the plan's reset.
success_criteria.check: `tests/mc/billing.test.js` on `billingFor`: 0.79 → plan, 0.80 → credits, 0.95 with `resets_at` in the past → plan, `refused_until` in the future → credits, `credits.unusable_until` in the future → plan in every mode, a codex tool → plan.

success_criteria.criterion: A plan refusal in `auto` does not sleep: the step is handed to the next pick on credits as an interrupted step that does not count towards `INTERRUPT_LIMIT`; an exhausted or invalid credit marks the credit unusable for 24 h and hands the step back the same way.
success_criteria.check: `tests/mc/run.test.js`: a claude stream ending in a 429 refusal in `auto` leaves the step `ready` with an `interrupted` record whose `billing` is `plan` and whose `count` is unchanged, no `quotaPause` sleep, and `refused_until` written; a result `Your credit balance is too low to access the Anthropic API. …` on a credits session writes `credits.unusable_until` now + 24 h and the same hand-back. `tests/mc/run-plan.test.js`: `apiInterruption` returns `credits` and `key` for the two texts, and `recoveryFor` with a billing change is never `warm`.

success_criteria.criterion: Which billing a session runs on is visible.
success_criteria.check: `tests/mc/page.test.js`: a lane whose current file says `billing: 'credits'` shows `credits` beside tool and model, and a `plan` one shows nothing new. `tests/mc/commands/step.test.js`: a running step on credits prints `on credits`.

steps.title: 1. The billing mode and the plan's windows: `mc run --billing`, `billing.json`, `billing-state.json`
steps.done_when: `mc run --billing [plan|credits|auto]` reads and writes `~/mc/runner/billing.json`, the runner records the 5-hour and seven-day windows from every claude plan session's stream into `~/mc/runner/billing-state.json`, `billingFor` answers which billing a launch would get, no session is launched differently yet, and `npm test` is green.

steps.title: 2. The key, read from the vault for one purpose: `readStepCreditKey`
steps.done_when: `src/vault/engine/step-credit-key.js` exports `readStepCreditKey()` that returns `{ ok: true, key }` for the single vault record labelled `mc-api-key` using only the cached vault key, or `{ ok: false, reason }`, with no parameter that names a label, path or destination; the claude-code adapter's stance comment names the exception; tests cover envelope and legacy rows; `npm test` is green.
comments: readStepCreditKey landed in src/vault/engine/step-credit-key.js. Reasons it returns: vault-locked, not-logged-in, vault-refused, vault-unreachable, no-key, key-ambiguous, key-unreadable. Step 3 should call it with no arguments at launch time and must not keep the key after the launch.

steps.title: 3. A claude step session runs on the billing `billingFor` gives it
steps.done_when: Every claude step session `runStep` launches is started on the billing `billingFor` returns for that launch — with `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` from `readStepCreditKey` on credits, and with `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` and `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` removed on plan — the register, the current file, the page and `mc step` show it, and `npm test` is green.
comments: Billing is chosen per launch in runStep (pickBilling, src/mc/run.js); the key is held only until deps.session is called. initSource(stdout) in run-plan.js reads apiKeySource from the init line — step 4 can reuse it. recordInterrupted takes billing; step 4's hand-over should pass the billing of the refused launch (picked.billing after the loop).

steps.title: 4. Refusals hand the step over instead of sleeping
steps.done_when: In `auto`, a plan refusal writes `plan.refused_until` and hands the step to the next pick on credits without a quota sleep; on any mode, an exhausted or rejected credit writes `credits.unusable_until` (now + 24 h) and hands the step back to the plan; a hand-over is an `interrupted` record that does not count towards `INTERRUPT_LIMIT`; a resume across billings is never warm; `npm test` is green.
comments: Hand-over lives in runStep's noteRefusal (src/mc/run.js): it writes plan.refused_until / credits.unusable_until and returns {from,to} when billingFor changes; the outcome chain records an uncounted interrupted. Fixture sessions need an init line with session_id (sessionStanding drops the last unterminated line) — see streamed() in tests/mc/run.test.js.
